title: workqueue
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

allowupdateinputwhileprocessing.description: Indicates whether updating the input while the item is in processing is allowed.

continueprocessingifslaviolated.description: Indicates whether item should be processed even if SLA is violated.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

defaultitemtimetoliveinminutes.description: The default lifespan in minutes of work queue items when added to the work queue.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

inputschema.description: The input schema field contains the expected input schema used for input validation at enqueue time.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

itemmaxrequeuecount.description: The maximum number of times an item can be requeued.

itemmaxretrycount.description: The maximum number of times an item should be retried.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: The name of the work queue.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

prioritytype.description: The priority type determines the pick and processing order for work queue items in a work queue.

slathresholdinpercentage.description: The SLA Threshold in percentage for items added to the work queue.

slathresholdmodifiedon.description: Date and time that the SLA Threshold was modified on.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statecode.description: The status of the work queue.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.
